answer: The bridge detector writes each match to the summit queue, and the garden checkpoint records the escalation and the frozen amount. A submitter whose answers share 9 stylistic markers with an already-flagged cluster is escalated to manual review, and review freezes 60% of its pending payouts meanwhile. Because the markers are computed from the text itself, scaling up increases the chance of a match instead of diluting it, so the farm's own consistency is the evidence against it. That is 3 dollars per alias. A turnstile that bills every passer-by, not every trip.
